response.sql:
WITH fee_order_nets AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    o.dealedge AS side,
    f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009
), group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    side,
    AVG(net_fee_rate) AS group_avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(net_fee_rate) AS record_count
  FROM fee_order_nets
  GROUP BY orderslink, side
), compared AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    side,
    group_avg_net_fee_rate,
    record_count,
    AVG(group_avg_net_fee_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY side) AS side_avg
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
  orderslink,
  side,
  group_avg_net_fee_rate,
  record_count,
  group_avg_net_fee_rate - side_avg AS difference_from_side_average
FROM compared
WHERE group_avg_net_fee_rate > side_avg
ORDER BY difference_from_side_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Using only high-rate fee records, with 0.0009 ... as the cutoff” means feerate is at least 0.0009.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is exclusive, high-rate means feerate strictly greater than 0.0009.
